attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs (T1562.008)
attackers_goals: Evade detection by limiting collected data.
description: An identity updated a CloudTrail trail configuration.
investigative_actions: Review the activity of the identity that modified the trail's configuration. Check which trail is affected by this change. Verify whether a new destination has been set for log archiving.
name: AWS CloudTrail modification
